23 November 2026

Order kaymak and smetana for the holidays early

From December the Combine makes extra kaymak, smetana and butter for the Christmas and New Year tables. Shops order through our sales office by the 15th of the month; families can ask their Bereke or Jıldız Market to put a tub aside.

Our 2-34-80-00 line takes orders from schools, hospitals and cafés as usual.

14 December 2026

Deliveries over Christmas and the New Year

On 24 and 31 December the vans leave an hour early and the last rounds finish by 14:00. There are no deliveries on 25 December or 1 January; on 28 December the rounds run as on a Saturday. Collection from the farms runs every day as usual.

The consumer line 2-34-80-00 is closed on 25 December and 1 January.

22 December 2026

Year-end bonus for members

The members' bonus for 2026 will be paid with the milk payment of 30 December, to Talasbank or Ak Bata Bank accounts or in cash at the collection points. Statements of each member's litres for the year are at the collection points from 23 December.

18 January 2027

Winter collection: route changes in the upper villages

Until the end of February routes 31 to 38 in the upper villages start from the collection points at 7:00 instead of 5:30, so that the tankers do not climb the side roads before they have been cleared. Evening milk is kept cold at the points overnight as usual.

15 February 2027

Kymyz contracts for summer 2027 open on 1 March

Herding families who want to supply mare's milk for Ak Bee this summer can sign their contracts at any collection point or at the Combine from 1 March to 15 April. Families who supplied in 2026 receive their forms through their point.

Our vets will visit the herds before the move to the high pastures, as every year.

4 March 2027

Deliveries over Irad Day and Nooruz

There are no deliveries to the shops on 11 March (Irad Day) or on Monday 22 March (Nooruz). On the day before each holiday the vans carry a double load of milk and kefir. Collection from the farms runs every day as usual.

25 March 2027

General meeting of the Cooperative on 17 April

The general meeting of the Talas Valley Milk Cooperative takes place on Saturday 17 April at 10:00 in the Combine's hall. On the agenda: the accounts for 2026, the members' bonus, school milk for 2027-2028 and the election of the board.

Members receive their papers through their collection point. A member who cannot come may give a written proxy to another member.

19 April 2027

Members approve the accounts for 2026

The general meeting approved the Combine's accounts for 2026 and elected the board of eleven for the coming year. Members voted to keep school milk in the Talas schools for another school year, together with the city education department.

Thank you to the 1,600 members who came to the hall, and to the cooks of the collection points for the plov.

3 May 2027

Kymyz muryndyk on Sunday 9 May

The season opens with the kymyz muryndyk on the pastures above Orto-Ayyl on Sunday 9 May. Collection trucks go up the next morning, and the first Ak Bee of 2027 should be in the shops by the middle of the week.

Neighbours and Combine families are welcome; the bus leaves the Combine gate at 8:00.

13 May 2027

The first Ak Bee of the year is in the shops

Young Ak Bee kymyz is on the shelves of Bereke and Jıldız Market in Talas from today, and in Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl from Saturday. Strong kymyz follows from June. Ak Bee is sold from May to September only.

Kymyz contains up to 2.4% alcohol. Not for children or drivers.

21 June 2027

Open day for member families on 3 July

Member families and their children can see the processing hall, the laboratory and the starter room on Saturday 3 July, 10:00 to 14:00. Bring the member's card to the gate. Children under twelve with an adult.

23 August 2027

School milk continues from 1 September

As agreed at the spring meeting, pupils in years one to four at the city's state schools will get their 200 ml of milk or kefir again from the first day of the school year, delivered with the morning rounds.

30 September 2027

The kymyz season closes

The last Ak Bee of 2027 was bottled this morning as the herds come down from the Talas Alatau. Thank you to the herding families and the drivers of the pasture routes. Ak Bee will be in the shops for a few more days.

The season's figures will be given to members at the spring meeting.

18 October 2027

Winter timetable from 15 November

With the herds down and milk falling to winter levels, the tanker routes go over to the winter timetable on 15 November. The three collection points at the foot of the pastures close until May. Members will find their route's times at their point.
